1. Make a copy of at most 512 pixels on the longer side.
2. Compute frequency-tuned and spectral residual saliency, edge density and a center prior.
3. Cluster the colors with k-means and score each cluster by saliency and how little of the border it covers.
4. Split the scores with Otsu's threshold and keep the strongest connected parts.
5. Fill holes, scale up to the image size and snap the edge to the image.
